description: Declared mutants of the kernel batches. kernel-scaffold (docs/architecture/plans/kernel/kernel-scaffold-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 5; ids ks-): spec J-9 guard, target/naming DI 1 and 3 guard, Delta-1 link check. registry-schedule (docs/architecture/plans/kernel/registry-schedule-declaration.zh-Hant.md, sections 5 and 6; ids rs-): spec J-10 to J-47 of the batch, the J.3 priority mutants 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11 and 14, the compile-failure samples (a) of J-10 (replacing the scaffold's sample mutants), and the writable-symbol guard (judgement 9). A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message (AGENTS 14.2); every check is a common test (no product test). Run from the repository root with python3 -I -B tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/kernel/scripts/mutations.json --build-dir <build dir with tests> --cmake <cmake>; the rs-sym- command mutants read the newest libgyo_kernel.a under build/ (the one the runner just rebuilt) and need nm on PATH; they run on macOS and Linux only. Later kernel batches add their mutants here. Initial value (Registrar::InitialValue; v8-arch-gyo2-funnel-check, ids rs-iv-): step 5a of the sync point, the declaration checks, the zone rules through the funnel (FunnelWrites) and the fingerprint sections. hook-flush (docs/architecture/target/v2/hook-flush-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 6 judgement 2; ids hf-): the hook rounds after the last sync point (spec F-12, J-54), the two-level limit, the fingerprint formats; plus the world-exec mutants (ids we-) of claude/arch-kernel-world-exec 50cb2050 whose find lies in the functions this batch changes, carried into gyo2 and re-run on its base (we-j7-despawn-reverse survives there: a known gap, reported). spawn-reject (docs/architecture/target/v2/spawn-reject-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 6 judgement 2; ids sr-): the sync point drops the spawn records it cannot apply (spec F-13, J-55); it removed we-adv-spawn-alive-assert-removed and we-adv-spawnwithid-allotter-range-assert-removed, whose find was a removed GYO_ASSERT (sr-assert-alive and sr-assert-range replace them).
